native.inheritedStyles: Panel/control/text/error colors, ordinary radii, hover/focus/disabled states, modal/popup elevation, and progress spinners use egui defaults.
native.previewPolicy: No HTML/CSS component translations or synthetic tonal ramps: the implemented system is native egui.
native.visualEvidenceScope: Light appearance at standard and compact window sizes; dark palette checked in source.

narrative.overview: Candy is a native macOS image utility in Operate mode: a familiar Preview-like workspace with the image in focus. Compact text controls, contextual options, document tabs, and a status strip surround the canvas. The application follows the system light or dark appearance.
keyCharacteristics: Text labels for editing tools and file actions.
Coral selection accents on neutral editor surfaces.
A flexible canvas with compact, wrapping control rows.
Visible document, selection, progress, and error state.
dos: Do keep the canvas as the main workspace.
Do use coral for selected tools, selected documents, and image-region outlines.
Do preserve system-following light and dark appearances.
Do retain text labels, contextual options, and visible status feedback.
donts: Don't add decorative cards or dashboard composition to the editor.
Don't treat the colors or typography inside an opened image as Candy interface tokens.
Don't replace inherited egui styles with guessed native or web values.
